On the x-axis, Year is drawn using a linear scale with a minimum of 2010 and a maximum of 2018. There is a linear scale from 0 to 5,000 along the y-axis, marked Number of foreigners in thousands.
caption_L2L3: The chart shows that there has been an increase in the foreign population living in Italy.  There has been an increase of 1650 thousand foreigners in Italy as in 2009 the population of foreigners was 3600 thousand but in 2019 the population of foreigners was 5250 thousand. The foreign population rose steeply between 2009 and 2014. The foreign population stayed at a similar level until 2017 when is started to gradually grow again.
